key_impacts: Severe social, economic, and psychological damages reported
evidence_snippets: 17th January 1995... an earthquake of Magnitude 7.9 shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo prefecture.
Destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
The impact... was visible in last year's Niigata Earthquake. With a 6.8 magnitude...
Damages to buildings in Niigita were high.
The human toll—35 lives lost—was far less severe.
